# KaTeX

Vendored from the official `katex@0.19.0` npm distribution (MIT license).
Includes KaTeX, auto-render, mhchem, and WOFF2 fonts. Keep LICENSE with these files.
CSS also lists WOFF/TTF fallbacks; WOFF2 is supported by the Android WebView and
browser versions targeted by this app, so only WOFF2 files are packaged.

Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser
Security options: https://katex.org/docs/security
Chemistry extension: https://katex.org/docs/node#using-mhchem-extension
